issues: No integrity or validity problems: no file or network access, no test-label use, and all randomness comes from the seed argument (seed+k for the forests, seed for XGB).
The gain of 0.0022 is within noise: recomputed z ≈ 0.257 (SE = 0.0070*sqrt(1+1/2) ≈ 0.00857), which matches the reported 0.258 up to rounding. The reject decision is consistent.
Two changes are made at once (3-seed forest ensemble and blend weights from 0.7/0.3 to 0.5/0.5), so any effect can't be credited to either one.
Averaging three forests with different seeds is close to just using one forest with 3x N_TREES; it adds code and fit time for little likely gain, against the 'simpler is better' rule.
